input.brief: Tell customers we are rolling out scheduled exports: reports can now be exported automatically on a daily or weekly schedule and sent straight to email, in CSV or PDF format. Available on all plans from today. Link to the help article.

subject_options: Export reports automatically, daily or weekly

blocks.summary: Export your reports automatically on a daily or weekly schedule.

blocks.text: From today, scheduled exports are available on all plans. Choose a schedule and your reports are sent straight to your email.
